item.title: Budget 2026: Finance chief defends plan to tap into Exchange Fund for Northern Metropolis project as ‘investment’
item.description: Hong Kong’s finance chief has defended the government’s plan to dip into a fund that ensures the stability of its currency peg to help finance a technology hub by the city’s border with mainland China, calling the move an “investment” rather than expenditure. item.title: US tech giant Meta sues Brazil, China advertisers over celebrity deepfake scams
item.description: US tech giant Meta filed lawsuits Thursday against several individuals and companies in Brazil and China who used celebrity deepfakes to advertise products on its platforms, the company said in a statement. item.title: ‘Deeply concerned’: China calls for Afghanistan-Pakistan ceasefire
item.description: China called on Friday for a ceasefire between Afghanistan and Pakistan, adding it was talking to both sides to try to end violent clashes that had left Beijing “deeply concerned”. Pakistan is one of China’s closest partners in the region, but Beijing also calls itself a “friendly neighbour” of Afghanistan. Foreign ministry spokeswoman Mao Ning […]

item.title: Budget 2026: ‘Symphony of Lights’ to be retired in 2nd half of year, replaced by light shows at tourist spots
item.description: Hong Kong’s 22-year-old nightly “A Symphony of Lights” harbour display has “completed its historical mission” and will be replaced by holiday-themed light shows at multiple tourist attractions, authorities have said.
